notes.title: Lantern of Worlds - The First Quest will be free to play.
notes.content:
Our game, [i]Lantern of Worlds - The First Quest[/i] will be free to play soon!

The game is getting a bit old, and is not really representative anymore of the quality we would like to see in our games. Therefore we have decided to make it free to play.

We would sincerely like to thank everyone who bought the game! 

We are currently working on a big update on Lantern of Worlds - The Story of Layla, and would like to continue the Lantern of Worlds story there.

Best regards,

Fabian Schurgers

notes.title: Website Updated! Let me tell you the story of Idunia!
notes.content:
The Fasold Games website has been updated!

You can now read the origin story for Lantern of Worlds and the Kingdom of Idunia!

Learn about the invaders from the North, the cruel Mountain Barons, the war of conquest and the rise of Branimir the Wizard.
Read about his rebellion, his success and his ultimate defeat at the hands of the royal knight Valdemar!


www.fasoldgames.com

notes.title: Lantern of Worlds - The Story of Layla 1.7 update!
notes.content:
The 3rd game in the [i]Lantern of Worlds[/i] series,[i] Lantern of Worlds - The Story of Layla[/i], has now been updated to version 1.7!

The new update contains:

- Choose your starting skills!

- Updated lighting

- improved skill screen.

Now, Layla is even better equipped to face the dangers of her adventure, and with your help, will surely win the day and become the Queen of Pirates!

The game is totally free, and can be found here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1047190/

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33706178/08f4a767b18e6a9f526e36980672afb0586b5540.jpg[/img]
